stem: A team asks for one universal cannabis-aphid count that automatically triggers treatment in every facility and crop stage. How should the specialist respond?
choices: Choose the lowest count reported online so the rule is conservative.

State that the cited hemp source did not establish a research-based action threshold and use validated facility/jurisdiction rules, comparable trends, crop impact and authorized decision criteria instead.
Use the same threshold as spider mites because both feed on plants.
Treat any single aphid detection as proof that the entire facility requires treatment.
rationale: The controlled hemp source explicitly notes that research-based action thresholds were not established in its production context, so the course must not manufacture a universal trigger.
